## Run 6 — SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

**Raw:** deep SdH from ≲ 1 T; minima touch ~0 Ω above 6 T (sawtooth, LL-like — hence the harmonic comb below); max 522 Ω = 10.4 % of the 5 kΩ FS, no clipping; T held 1.25 K; no gate leakage beyond the flyback-transient band. **Onset:** censored at 1.0 T — the analysis is restricted to the 10 mT fine grid (B ≥ 1 T) because the 0–1 T 50 mT leg under-samples the 7.3 T tone in 1/B below ~0.85 T; oscillations persist to the fine grid's low edge, so onset ≤ 1.0 T (hole side measured 0.71 T, run 7). **Tones (vs `fs_count_b0`, run-5 cal, geometry-prior scale):** dominant **7.3 T = ABAB light pocket predicted 7.31 T** (scale 1.00) with a harmonic comb 2×–18× (sawtooth), and a strong tone at **29.4 T (SNR 115)** that is *degenerate* between 4×7.3 = 29.2 and the **region-B mosaic heavy pocket 28.8 T** (region B is +0.43×10¹² doped, run 5). **Tension to resolve:** ABAB heavy-A predicted 25.8 T shows **no distinct peak** — either genuinely weak (Dingle/spin node) with 29.4 a pure harmonic, or the pair is (7.3, 29.4) with sum 36.7 = 1.11·F_L (inside the lever-arm band, but a global 1.11 rescale then mispredicts the light tone at 8.4) — a fork, not a read. **Against ABCA:** a dominant 7.3 T tone at F_L = 33.1 T is inconsistent with a single Fermi surface (would need scale ×0.22); electron side is strongly multi-tone. **Spot verdict: consistent-with ABAB (+ region-B mosaic), pending the fan's F(n) trajectories** — a harmonic tracks 4·f_light(n) exactly, a heavy branch tracks its own Onsager curve (at n = 2.0: 4·f_light = 14.2 vs heavy 17.1 vs region-B heavy 20.3 — cleanly split).

"""sdh-spot-check run 6 — electron side, n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0->10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above).
Raw MR first; onset + tones on the trustworthy fine grid (B >= 1 T: the 50 mT leg
under-samples the 7.3 T tone below ~0.85 T in 1/B); FFT vs model tone predictions."""
import sys
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs, abca_fs

IB, SENS = 10e-9, 50e-6
rid, n_spot = 6, 3.2e12  # cm^-2 units below; model takes m^-2
r6 = run(rid)
print(summarize_run(r6))
B6 = r6.col("magnet_field"); R6 = r6.col("sr1_X") / IB
i = np.argsort(B6); B6, R6 = B6[i], R6[i]
FL6 = luttinger_frequency(n_spot * 1e4)  # m^-2
_, ab = abab_fs(n_spot * 1e4); f_light, f_heavy = ab[0][0], ab[1][0]
*_, F_abca = abca_fs(n_spot * 1e4)
_, abB = abab_fs((n_spot + 0.43e12) * 1e4)  # region-B mosaic: +0.43e12 doped

# --- raw first ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.2))
ax.plot(B6, R6, lw=0.5, color="k")
ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="R_xx (Ohm)", title=f"run 6 raw — n = +3.2e12, D = 0, sr1 50 uV (FS 5 kOhm), T ~ {np.nanmedian(r6.col('T_sample')):.2f} K")
plt.show()

# --- onset: fine grid only (B >= 1 T) ---
m = B6 >= 0.999
on6 = sdh_onset(R6[m], B6[m], r_full_scale=SENS / IB, b_lo=1.0)
print(on6.summary())

# --- FFT vs model ---
freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R6[m][:, None], B6[m], b_range=(1.0, 10.0), nfft=4096)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.2))
ax.plot(freqs, spec[0], lw=0.8, color="k")
for f, lab, c in [(f_light, f"ABAB light {f_light:.1f}", "tab:blue"), (f_heavy, f"ABAB heavy {f_heavy:.1f}", "tab:red"),
                  (FL6, f"F_L {FL6:.1f} (= ABCA {F_abca:.1f})", "tab:green"), (abB[1][0], f"region-B heavy {abB[1][0]:.1f}", "tab:orange")]:
    ax.axvline(f, color=c, ls="--", lw=1, label=lab)
for k in (2, 3, 4):
    ax.axvline(k * 7.3, color="gray", ls=":", lw=0.8)
ax.set(xlim=(0, 45), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="log FFT amp", title="run 6 FFT (1/B), B 1-10 T, bg_degree 5; gray dots: k x 7.3 T harmonics")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.show()
print(f"model (run-5 cal, geometry-prior scale): F_L = {FL6:.1f} T; ABAB pair = {f_light:.2f} / {f_heavy:.2f} T; "
      f"ABCA singleton = {F_abca:.2f} T; region-B (n+0.43e12) ABAB pair = {abB[0][0]:.2f} / {abB[1][0]:.2f} T")

## Run 7 — SdH spot check, hole side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = −1.2×10¹², D = 0, B 10 → 0.3 T

**Raw:** fast near-CNP oscillations visible from ~0.5 T; max 576 Ω = 11.5 % FS, no clipping; T 1.25 K. TG current sat at a sustained ≈ −103 pA median (vs ~0 on run 6) — an offset at the negative TG bias point, flat in B, not a runaway; watch it on the fan's low-n columns. **Onset: 0.71 T, a measured die-off** (the 20 mT grid resolves the 6.6 T tone down to 0.51 T — unlike run 6's censored edge). **Tones (vs model at −1.2×10¹²):** a close pair **4.7 / 6.6 T ≈ the ABAB near-CNP pair predicted 5.9 / 6.5 T** (the recipe's close+balanced exception regime); pair sum 11.3 T vs F_L = 12.4 T (−9 %, inside the scale band). A strong tone at **12.3 T (SNR 125) ≈ F_L = 12.41 T** — the investigation's mandatory-discrimination case: ABAB magnetic-breakdown sum-tone (symmetry-allowed, expected) vs an ABCA singleton; note ABCA's singleton here carries m* = 1.12 mₑ, LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K but only ~2× damped at 10 T if T_e ≈ lattice 1.25 K — the harmonic comb on run 6 already argues T_e well below the 8 K lore, so temperature alone does not kill the ABCA reading of this tone; the B-window split + LK mass (investigation Verify) will. An unassigned 8.5 T tone (SNR 46, no harmonic flag) is a candidate region-B feature (region-B hole density −0.77×10¹²: F_L,B = 8.0 T) — fork to report. **Spot verdict: consistent-with ABAB near-CNP pair + F_L-tone (origin undiscriminated); side is exception-regime by gate-range construction (|n| ≤ 1.27×10¹²), so the classification weight stays on the electron side.** Sensitivity 50 µV and τ = 0.3 s validated at both density extremes → the fan inherits them.

"""sdh-spot-check run 7 — hole side, n = -1.2e12, D = 0, B 10->0.3 T uniform 20 mT (ride-down).
Raw MR first; onset + tones (20 mT grid resolves the ~6.6 T tone down to ~0.5 T, so the
0.71 T onset is a measured die-off, unlike run 6's censored edge); FFT vs model tones."""
import sys
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs, abca_fs, abca_mstar

IB, SENS = 10e-9, 50e-6
r7 = run(7)
print(summarize_run(r7))
B7 = r7.col("magnet_field"); R7 = r7.col("sr1_X") / IB
i = np.argsort(B7); B7, R7 = B7[i], R7[i]
FL7 = luttinger_frequency(1.2e12 * 1e4)
_, ab7 = abab_fs(-1.2e12 * 1e4)
*_, F_abca7 = abca_fs(-1.2e12 * 1e4)
_, m_abca7 = abca_mstar(-1.2e12 * 1e4)

# --- raw first ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.2))
ax.plot(B7, R7, lw=0.5, color="k")
ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="R_xx (Ohm)", title=f"run 7 raw — n = -1.2e12, D = 0, sr1 50 uV (FS 5 kOhm), T ~ {np.nanmedian(r7.col('T_sample')):.2f} K")
plt.show()

# --- onset ---
on7 = sdh_onset(R7, B7, r_full_scale=SENS / IB)
print(on7.summary())

# --- FFT vs model ---
freqs7, spec7 = sdh_fft(R7[:, None], B7, b_range=(0.71, 10.0), nfft=4096)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.2))
ax.plot(freqs7, spec7[0], lw=0.8, color="k")
for f, lab, c in [(ab7[0][0], f"ABAB pair {ab7[0][0]:.1f}", "tab:blue"), (ab7[1][0], f"/ {ab7[1][0]:.1f}", "tab:red"),
                  (FL7, f"F_L {FL7:.1f} (= ABCA {F_abca7:.1f}, m* {m_abca7:.2f} m_e)", "tab:green")]:
    ax.axvline(f, color=c, ls="--", lw=1, label=lab)
ax.set(xlim=(0, 35), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="log FFT amp", title="run 7 FFT (1/B), B 0.71-10 T, bg_degree 5")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.show()
print(f"model: F_L = {FL7:.1f} T; ABAB near-CNP pair = {ab7[0][0]:.2f} / {ab7[1][0]:.2f} T (close+balanced regime); "
      f"ABCA singleton = {F_abca7:.2f} T at m* = {m_abca7:.2f} m_e (LK-dead at T_e ~ 8 K if real)")

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — the stacking-call fan

> **05:32** · landau-fan-vti: D=0 electron, n +0.6..+3.2e12 (91 pts, dn 0.029e12) x B 0.6->10 T uniform-1/B (157 rows, d(1/B) 0.01004), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), ends 10 T at n=+3.2 spot · **ETA ~15:02** (≈9h30m)

**Why this fan (investigation Step 4, from the run-6/7 spot reads in ana):** the electron spot at +3.2×10¹² shows the ABAB-light-predicted 7.3 T tone (model 7.31) with a harmonic comb, and a strong 29.4 T tone degenerate between 4×7.3 = 29.2, the region-B mosaic heavy pocket (28.8), and a displaced heavy-A; the hole spot shows the near-CNP pair + a 12.3 T ≈ F_L tone of undiscriminated origin. Frequencies alone cannot split these — **F(n) trajectories can**: a harmonic tracks k·f_light(n) exactly, heavy-A tracks the ABAB curve (17.1 T at n = 2.0, where 4·f_light = 14.2 and region-B heavy = 20.3 — all cleanly split by the record's δF ≈ 1.1 T), an ABCA singleton tracks F_L, and the partition sum f₁+f₂ = F_L is checked per column. Electron side per the investigation's no-side-prior rule: it alone reaches the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design densities (hole side is TG-capped at −1.27×10¹², inside the exception regime).

**Design (floored per `landau-fan.md` step 1):** B slow, uniform-1/B, **0.6 → 10 T, 157 rows** — Δ(1/B) = 0.01004 ≤ 1/(3·F_L(3.2×10¹²)) (Nyquist at the highest-n column, margin ⅓); B_lo = 0.6 T sits under the measured hole onset (0.71 T, run 7) and the electron censored bound (≤ 1.0 T, run 6), and buys ≥ 5 light-tone periods for n ≥ 2.0×10¹²; B_hi = 10 T is the session cap and nearly free in 1/B (rows 8→10 T: 3). Fast axis: paired (V_tg, V_bg) n-line at D = 0, **n = +0.6 → +3.2×10¹², 91 pts** (Δn = 0.029×10¹² = ray-Nyquist floor at 0.6 T; window spans the light-pocket-emptying signature near 0.8×10¹² up to the TG-limited maximum). Sensitivity **50 µV fixed** (5 kΩ FS): worst corner is low-n × high-B — anchored at R₀(n = 0.6, run 5) = 153 Ω × the measured near-CNP MR+SdH factor ≈ 2.3 (run 7) ≈ 0.4 kΩ ≪ FS; both spot extremes peaked ≤ 12 % FS. Dwell: fast_delay = 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — per-column-FFT floor, base step 7), slow_delay = 1.

**Coverage trade:** hole side excluded (exception regime by gate construction, already spot-checked at −1.2×10¹²; adding it costs ≈ +3.6 h — a follow-up mini-fan if the call needs hole-side F(n)); n < 0.6×10¹² excluded (CNP approach, tones unresolvable and R rising).

**Price** (calibrated on run 5: 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0 → reads ≈ 0.10 s/pt): grid 157×91×1.90 s = 7.5 h + traverse 9.4 T/0.137 = 1.15 h + settles/turnaround ≈ 0.2 h + start ramps ≈ 0.1 h ≈ **9.0 h; headline 9.5 h** (session actuals run over the bracket). Ends at **10 T, gates at the +3.2×10¹² spot** — the LK mass split (temperature-dependence Flavor B) or a firming leg rides the field down; no re-traverse.

**Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed, digests per B-row): (1) first ~3 rows (~12 min) — rail/dead channel/leakage (watch the −103 pA TG offset seen on run 7's negative-V_tg... n/a here: V_tg ≥ +0.24 V, expect run-6-like ~0 pA), T at base, gates tracking the n-line; (2) row ~66 (B = 1.0 T, ~3.8 h) — interim per-column FFT of landed rows: light-branch F(n) forming? (3) row ~117 (B = 2.0 T, ~6.4 h) — interim read of the heavy/F_L band trajectories; abandon/adjust call at each (an early wash-out saves the remaining hours). Leak trip in-cell at 1 nA.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): D = 0 electron side, n +0.6 -> +3.2e12 (91 pts) x B 0.6 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (157 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_N, N_B = 91, 157
ns = np.linspace(0.6, 3.2, N_N)                      # 1e12 cm^-2, ascending (row ends at the n = +3.2 spot)
Ds = np.zeros(N_N)                                   # V/nm
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert (Vtgs >= TG_MIN).all() and (Vtgs <= TG_MAX).all() and (Vbgs >= BG_MIN).all() and (Vbgs <= BG_MAX).all()
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1 / 0.6, 1 / 10.0, N_B)    # uniform in 1/B, ascending 0.6 -> 10 T
d_invB = (1 / 0.6 - 1 / 10.0) / (N_B - 1)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"fast n-line: {N_N} pts, n +0.60 -> +3.20e12 (dn = {(ns[1]-ns[0]):.4f}e12 <= ray-Nyquist 0.029e12 at 0.6 T); "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V")
print(f"slow B: {N_B} rows, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; d(1/B) = {d_invB:.5f} 1/T <= 1/(3*F_L(3.2e12)=33.1 T) = 0.01007")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan opens with a 0 -> 0.6 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- lock-in: fixed for the whole fan, inherited from spot checks (runs 6/7: no clip at either density extreme) ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS at 10 nA), tau {_tau} s, slope {_slope} dB/oct; fast_delay 1.8 s = 6*tau")
assert _tau <= 0.31, f"tau changed ({_tau} s): fast_delay 1.8 s is sized as 6*tau for tau = 0.3 s"

I_TRIP = 1e-9
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti: D = 0 electron, n +0.6 -> +3.2e12 ({N_N} pts) x B 0.6 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows), "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = +0.00 V/nm, n = +0.60 to +3.20e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts), B = 0.6 to 10 T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) = {d_invB:.5f} 1/T); '
              f'sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), slow_delay 1; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; inherits sdh-spot-check runs 6/7 '
              f'(onset 0.71 T hole / <=1.0 T electron; F_L partition vs harmonic-comb fork to resolve by F(n))')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)
# end state: B = 10 T, gates at the n = +3.2e12 spot — the LK / firming leg rides the field down from here; no park.

assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0 - 10.0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B, descending (blocking magnet; start where it sits). F_L(1.2e12) = 12.4 T.
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
